notes: ἀγαπητῷ τέκνῳ is anarthrous throughout, so rule 58 puts the supplied possessive my on the noun and leaves the adjective bare, discontinuously under rule 15.
τοῦ before κυρίου ἡμῶν is emptied by the free genitive ἡμῶν under rule 20 proper; the ASV writes no juncture between Grace, mercy, peace, so nothing is added.
